newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar heads lower to keep pace with NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar heads lower to keep pace with NY.

text.p: White sugar futures turned lower in modest Wednesday trading as players moved in to keep pace with the falling New York market.
Light arbitrage activity was reported amid crossed dealings but traders said activity was generally subdued.
"I think people are just taking the opportunity to sell London whites at these levels as they're expecting New York to drift down a touch," said one.
"It's all very dull...when you take into consideration the crossed-up trade there's not really that much around."
At 1530 GMT all positions were hovering at intraday lows, with spot August down $1.80 at $311.50 and October down $1.90 at $303.10. Volume reached 1,570 lots, mainly in the two front months.
Traders said one leading commission house had been prominent on the sell side during afternoon activity, balanced by buying from a number of brokers.
London's August/October spread traded at around $8.50, slightly narrower than in recent days.
In Paris trading was subdued with just 169 lots of August posted on the board. The position was $1.50 lower at $311.10.
